questions.question_text: Which Azure service provides managed file shares in the cloud?
questions.explanation: Azure Files is a fully managed service that provides SMB file shares in the cloud.

questions.question_text: Which access level provides anonymous read access to the container and its blobs?

options.label: B
options.text: Public (Blob) access – anonymous read for blobs only

options.label: C
options.text: Public (Container) access – anonymous read for containers and blobs

questions.explanation: Public (Container) access allows anyone to read data in the container and its blobs without authentication.

questions.question_text: Which storage tier in Azure Blob Storage is optimized for data that is accessed less than once per month?
questions.explanation: The Archive tier is designed for infrequently accessed data with the lowest storage cost.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of soft delete for Azure Files?

options.label: C
options.text: Retains deleted files for a specified period before permanent deletion

questions.explanation: Soft delete keeps a deleted file for a configurable retention period, allowing recovery before permanent removal.

questions.question_text: How many snapshots can be taken for an Azure Blob?
questions.explanation: Azure Blob Storage allows up to 50 snapshots per blob.

questions.question_text: Which lifecycle management action can be used to transition blobs from the hot tier to the cool tier after 30 days?
questions.explanation: Lifecycle management rules with a transition action move blobs between tiers after a specified number of days.

questions.question_text: When configuring versioning for an Azure File share, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: Versioning is enabled per file, not per share.

options.label: B
options.text: Versioning retains multiple versions of a file within the same share.

options.label: C
options.text: Versioning can only be disabled, not enabled.

options.label: D
options.text: Versioning stores versions in a separate container.

questions.explanation: File versioning keeps a history of multiple versions of each file inside the same file share.

questions.question_text: Which of the following best describes the purpose of a blob snapshot?

options.label: B
options.text: It creates a read‑only copy of the blob at a point in time.

options.label: D
options.text: It moves the blob to a different storage account.

questions.explanation: A snapshot is a read‑only point‑in‑time copy of a blob, useful for backup and recovery.

questions.question_text: In Azure Files, what is the recommended practice for enabling soft delete?

options.label: A
options.text: Enable it only for premium files.

options.label: B
options.text: Enable it at the storage account level.

questions.explanation: Soft delete is a setting applied to the storage account, protecting all file shares within it.

questions.question_text: Which storage tier is most cost‑effective for rarely accessed data that does not require high performance?
questions.explanation: The Archive tier offers the lowest cost for data that is accessed very infrequently.
